changeLog: New in this version: the Water layout choice is a list, with the picture and description of the layout you highlight beside it; the Scenario Description in the random map lobby shows the chosen template's own description; a click on the small map picture shows it full screen, with the underground one arrow away; a failed update says why; the AI Settings window lists a computer player from a mod that cannot load, in grey, with the reason, and watching a game no longer fills the log with errors. The map pictures with terrain colours and the random water amount need OmniMapGen 0.3.36, offered in the launcher's mod list. Everyone who plays together should update.
